docs.title: Lodestar sea rover
docs.text:
Lodestar — Sea Rover 6★ Annihilation Wrath Single-target Kit Build & Synergies Review STATS & REFLECTION Lv.100 Base Stats HP 33,831 ATK 18,755 DEF 11,061 Reflection ATK +42% CRIT Rate +33.6% DMG +36.48% RECONSTRUCTION TRAITS S-trait Raging Sea Assault ULT's CRIT DMG gain increases to 11%. A-trait Tactical Balance CRIT Rate +20%, CRIT DMG -20%. A-trait All or Nothing ATK +25%, HP -12%. A-trait Fleeting Brilliance Passive cooldown -5s. DUPES D1 ULT hit count +4; ATK +7%. D2 CRIT Rate +10%. D3 3rd Aptitude +1; ATK +21%. SKILLS Basic Shotgun Single-target Deals 126% ATK as DMG to an enemy. Passive 15s cooldown Single-target Fires 11 bullets toward the current target, each dealing 31% ATK damage. Ultimate 3 Flames Single-target Deals 95% ATK ×12 to random enemies in a circular area. Each repeated hit on the same target grants +6% CRIT DMG for 10s. Recommended Investment Position Off-field > On-field Skill Target 1/1/10 Recon Priority 1 A-trait Tactical Balance 2 S-trait or A-trait Except Fleeting Brilliance Special Synergies

Coming soon.

  • ULT grants a 10s buff — the fewer enemies it hits, the stronger.
  • Lacks innate CRIT Rate.
  • A-trait Tactical Balance enables off-field positioning.
  • Without Tactical Balance, Lodestar needs on-fielding for allied CRIT buffs.
